scope: Pinned layout-aware keyboard-trial sources for a source-only, locally built sam-sargo trial bundle. This records source and build identities only; it does not describe a device, installed deployment, image or package set.

path_dependencies.note: Cargo.lock records package versions but does not pin path-dependency commits, so each checkout commit is verified explicitly before building.

stevia.role: C Meson client; produces phosh-osk-stevia and the mobi.phosh.osk GSettings schema
stevia.note: This commit only changes the Python native test stand-in. The compiled C binary is byte-comparable to the tested parent 8f8b6bdc649b520cfa4210dc9c22e0af7b76039a; that parent's own parent is the exporter commit e688e6a2d48eec1bf26c55e102061cfbac8c025b.

verbisage.role: Rust D-Bus language service and CLI; produces verbisaged and verbisage (swipe layout and Patricia backends are behind features)
verbisage.note: Documentation-only child of the tested commit 34f2a1ca7160812fa8d47565dcc0ddf664c4906b; the release build uses --all-features.

keyboard_layout.role: Shared Rust geometry and layout-format crate

patricia_dict.role: Rust Patricia reader crate and developer CLI used by the Verbisage Patricia backend
patricia_dict.note: Submodule of verbisage at path patricia_dict; Cargo.lock does not pin its commit.

drift-type.role: Private Rust gesture-decoder crate used by the Verbisage swipe feature
drift-type.note: Private source. Authorized local consumption only; do not publish source, logs or private paths in public artifacts.
